about.description: SAIGON ID Construction & Architecture Co., Ltd. (SID). “ID” stands for Identity - an exact likeness in nature or qualities; it also reflects Ideas in design and Interior & Design. We believe every home and every work deserves its own unique “ID”, reflecting individual taste, lifestyle, and values. Beyond design, we also execute interior - exterior decoration and woodworking production.

infrastructure.description: With a 900 m² factory, we have invested in production and woodworking machinery that meet stringent requirements and large order volumes.

hero.title: About Us
hero.description: SAIGON ID Construction & Architecture Co., Ltd. (abbreviated as SID). “ID” stands for Identity; it also hints at Ideas in design, and Interior & Design. We believe every home and every work deserves its own “ID” that reflects taste, lifestyle, and personal values. Besides design, we also deliver interior - exterior fit-out and in-house woodworking.

mvv.mission_description: Our foremost purpose is to leverage people, experience, and creativity to deliver the best interior products to our clients.
mvv.values_description: Earning trust and serving customer satisfaction is our top priority. Projects: durable, beautiful, and on schedule. Professional consulting and design services. A creative and efficient workplace. A united and friendly team.
mvv.vision_description: Develop the SAIGON ID image through relentless creativity in design and ever-improving product quality with a skilled workforce—striving to become a leading interior design & build firm in Vietnam.

factory.title: Manufacturing Facility
factory.description: With a 900 m² factory, we have invested in a full suite of production machinery and woodworking equipment to meet stringent requirements and large order volumes from our clients.

balisa-hotel.title: BALISA HOTEL
balisa-hotel.description: Located in District 1, HCMC - Balisa Hotel is a premium handover project. The lobby uses luxurious materials—stone, metal, and glass—for a modern, refined feel. It showcases our ability to turn ideas into real spaces that elevate the stay experience downtown.

penthouse-mr-quang.title: PENTHOUSE MR QUANG
penthouse-mr-quang.description: A luxurious yet cozy space featuring velvet and leather sofas with gold-toned metal accents. The layout is thoughtfully organized to optimize both functionality and aesthetics for comfortable living.

chung-cu-estalla.title: ESTELLA APARTMENT
chung-cu-estalla.location: Estella Apartment – Ho Chi Minh City
chung-cu-estalla.description: Minimal, modern “WASABI” style with light wood tones and warm lighting. Smart built-ins, soft curves, and natural wood create a cozy yet refined home.

apec-mandala.title: APEC MANDALA CHARM BAY
apec-mandala.description: Warm interior with minimal lines and meticulous finishes. The overall vibe is relaxing and elegant—fitting for a premium resort destination. The overall space brings relaxation and elegance—aligned with premium hospitality standards at a renowned Vietnamese destination.

kien-long-bank.title: KIEN LONG BANK
kien-long-bank.description: A modern, signature white trading-office interior reflecting a bank in transformation and oriented toward optimal customer experience.

pizza-4ps.title: PIZZA 4P'S
pizza-4ps.location: AEON Tan Phu – Ho Chi Minh City
pizza-4ps.description: A contemporary, minimalist yet refined ambiance with natural wood columns adding warmth. Muted dark tones and soft amber lighting create a welcoming but upscale dining atmosphere—expressing the creative identity of Pizza 4P’s.

coffee-shop.title: COFFEE SHOP
coffee-shop.location: Buon Ma Thuot City – Dak Lak
coffee-shop.description: A modern café space that’s warm and minimal. Natural wood, gentle warm lighting, and large glazing provide an airy, nature-friendly feel. Flexible seating suits groups and solo visitors alike—friendly, youthful, and subtly elegant.

penthouse-masteri.title: PENTHOUSE MASTERI
penthouse-masteri.location: Thao Dien – Ho Chi Minh City
penthouse-masteri.description: Modern minimalism with neutral tones and natural materials—elegant yet warm. A harmonious layout reflects refined, contemporary living.

phuc-long-coffee.title: PHUC LONG COFFEE
phuc-long-coffee.description: A modern, cozy coffee space with natural wood, neutral tones, and soft warm light. Diverse seating supports different groups and use cases. Greenery and delicate décor deliver a relaxing, friendly atmosphere that remains refined.

hero.title: Furniture
hero.description: We provide a full range of furniture - including tables, chairs, cabinets, beds, and more-crafted through a careful manufacturing process to ensure both durability and visual appeal. Our products feature a modern and refined design language, making them easy to pair with different interior styles. With diverse materials and styles available, clients can select pieces that perfectly suit their home or office.

design_build.title: Interior Design & Construction
design_build.description: We provide end-to-end interior design and build services, from concept consulting and detailed drawings to on-site implementation. Every project is crafted to meet functional needs while expressing the owner's personal style. Our architects and skilled craftsmen ensure schedule and quality, delivering a truly finished living space.

hospitality.title: Restaurant & Hotel Setup
hospitality.description: Drawing on extensive experience in F&B and hospitality, we deliver complete setup solutions for restaurants and hotels, from interior fit-out and display layouts to functional zoning. We aim to build professional, elegant spaces that offer comfort and leave a lasting impression. From concept to final handover, we work closely with clients to ensure consistency, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness

factory.title: Manufacturing Facility
factory.description:
To deliver top-quality products, we apply strict procedures at every stage. From material selection and processing to final finishing, each step is handled with care to meet technical standards at the highest level.

With a 900 m² factory, we have invested in production machinery and woodworking equipment that meet stringent requirements and support large order volumes.

painting.title: Painting Area
painting.description: With a dedicated painting zone, we ensure the finished surface is consistently smooth, evenly colored, and durable over time. Our tightly controlled process meets demanding requirements for longevity. Every detail is carefully inspected so products reach customers in the best possible condition.
